label: 2. How did everyone do on the exam?

lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 102810105 · After Final Exams Strategy chat 1. Ein has invited {AccountData.NickName} to join…

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: How did everyone do on the exam?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Terrible.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Ha!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: You've really given up, haven't you?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Give up? What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: You're just so adorable, that's all.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: What about you, Zwei?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Same as usual.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Does that mean you did well?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Hard to say.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I'll take that as a yes, ha.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I never said that.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: How was it invigilating the exam, Teacher?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Did you see how hard I was working? Did I nail it?
The funniest part was when you were struggling to stay awake.
You clearly were working very hard to answer all the questions.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Ha! You had a hard time staying awake?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I did not!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I was still able to hand in my exam paper!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Are we supposed to think that's impressive?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Were you able to answer all the questions, Rei?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Of course! I'm a senior, after all!
You started nodding off 5 minutes after you started writing.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: lolololololol

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I knew it.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: That's not true!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Naru said it was a solid seven minutes before I nodded off.
Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: So take that!
Well, regardless, thank you for your hard work, everyone.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Hee hee. Thank you, Teacher.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Not sure if that really applies to me,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: but thanks anyway, Teach!
